current.text: Holland is projected to come off the bench in Detroit. He is the second reserve, behind sixth man Isaiah Joe and ahead of Paul Reed and Daniss Jenkins. The projected starting five is unchanged from last season and does not include him.
He is expected to play more minutes alongside Ausar Thompson this season instead of having his minutes staggered with him.
Detroit's power forward depth is very weak, which could open minutes at the four for him and Ausar Thompson.
Detroit plays 4, 3 and 4 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21. The team has 15 back-to-backs, and no rest risk is expected.

tags.name: deep rotation
tags.detail: Detroit used a 12 to 13 player rotation last season that limited everyone's minutes. Holland is a bench piece in it.

note: Both sites value Holland at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 269, ESPN rank 245) and he went undrafted in our league last season, so he falls outside our 144-player draft. His projected line is thin across the board: 8 points and 0.6 threes, with few turnovers and about 1 steal as the only small pluses. He is not a draft target. Early in the season, check whether more minutes alongside Ausar Thompson or at power forward push him clearly above last season's 19.8 minutes. That is the only path to waiver value.
